channel.description: Press releases and breaking news, Tampa Bay

item.title: [ABC Action News / Tampa Bay 28] Singer D4vd must stand trial in killing of 14-year-old Celeste Rivas Hernandez
item.description: A judge ruled Monday that there is enough evidence to put singer D4vd on trial in the killing and dismemberment of 14-year-old Celeste Rivas Hernandez after, authorities said, she had threatened to expose their relationship and crater his career.

item.title: [ABC Action News / Tampa Bay 28] As flooding becomes more frequent, St. Pete gets $2.2 million for 2 key projects
item.description: St. Petersburg is receiving more than $2.2 million in federal funding to help speed up two stormwater projects aimed at reducing chronic flooding in some of the city's most flood-prone areas.

item.title: [ABC Action News / Tampa Bay 28] Trump administration urges Supreme Court to allow order targeting mail-in voting before midterms
item.description: The Trump administration asked the Supreme Court on Monday to clear the way for an executive order from President Donald Trump that could dramatically change mail-in voting.

item.title: [ABC Action News / Tampa Bay 28] Questions remain after FHP pursuit ends in crash that kills 15-year-old passenger in Pasco County
item.description: Florida Highway Patrol continues to investigate a pursuit that ended in a crash Sunday morning, killing a 15-year-old passenger and seriously injuring the 15-year-old driver.
